newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani stocks end down on institutions selling.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani stocks end down on institutions selling.

text.p: Pakistani stocks ended down on Monday amid selling by financial institutions and dealers said scrips were likely to ease further due to profit-taking on Tuesday's clearing day.
In spite of gains in the bellwether PTCL and HUBCO, strong across-the-board selling by cash-short local institutions forced the Karachi 100-share index down 1.9 percent, dealer Asif Janmohammad said.
The index ended 31.64 points down at 1,635.41 amid 259 losers and 34 gainers. Turnover rose to 60 million from Friday's 40.8 million.
One broker said a technical correction was inevitable after a recent rally based more on sentiment than fundamentals.
Engro Chemical fell 5.0 rupees to 178, Al-Faysal Bank 2.75 to 19.25, Askari Bank 2.90 to 29.10 and Bank of Punjab 2.65 to 29.75. PTCL rose 0.65 to 30.35 and HUBCO 0.35 to 40.10.
